question: What are the proposal submission deadlines in the custody (master custodian / global custody) RFPs in the corpus?
gold_answer: OCERS (custody services RFP, Oct 2022): 5:00 p.m. PST, November 15, 2022. CCCERA (master custodian RFP, Apr 2018): 5:00 p.m. PT, Friday, May 25, 2018. TMRS (global custody RFP, Dec 2020): January 27, 2021 by 5:00 PM CT. SBCERS (custody RFP): February 2, 2024, 6 PM ET (by email).
acceptance: Require four issuers with dates, times and time zones. Equivalent time-zone conversions are acceptable if explicit. 'By email' and issuance dates are optional.
candidate_answer:
